observation_indicators.observable_fil: Para sa Ampalaya, itugma ang botanical name, bahagi at nakalistang gamit. Ipaliwanag ang hangganan at konsultasyon.
observation_indicators.observable_en: For Ampalaya, match the botanical name, plant part and listed use. Explain the boundary and consultation need.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Sinasabing puwedeng ipalit ang ampalaya o bawasan ang gamot ni Joel, o nagmumungkahi ng dami.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Says Ampalaya can replace or reduce Joel’s medicine, or suggests an amount.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naitutugma ang Momordica charantia, dahon at nakalistang gamit, hindi binabago ang gamot ni Joel, at iniuugnay siya sa clinician nang walang paalala.
levels.kaya_na_en: Matches Momordica charantia, leaves and listed use, keeps Joel’s medicine unchanged, and refers him to his clinician without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naitutugma ang card ngunit kailangan ng paalala na huwag baguhin ang gamot o kung sino ang magpapasya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Matches the card but needs a prompt to keep the medicine unchanged or to name who decides.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Sinasabing puwedeng ipalit ang ampalaya o bawasan ang gamot ni Joel, o nagmumungkahi ng dami.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Says Ampalaya can replace or reduce Joel’s medicine, or suggests an amount.
